answer: Divergent Quorum Challenge. On registration, each identity emits an unpredictable response to a seed derived from live network noise (a "quartz" entropy pulse) and commits its hash. Later, challengers broadcast a fresh seed; every identity must answer instantly, and honest agents answer via a hidden per-agent path, so a clone sharing that path could only answer by copying the original—which the timing window forbids. A "whisper" channel carries the seed with per-agent jitter, and a "prism" check splits responses across independent verifiers,
